topic: Myth: a simple app doesn't need a backend
caption:
Myth: “My app is simple, so it doesn't need a backend.” 📱

The screens might be simple. What sits behind them usually isn't.

The moment your app has logins, saves data across devices, takes payments, sends notifications or shows the same information to more than one person, it needs a server and a database somewhere.

Some apps really don't: a calculator, an offline tool, a single-user utility. For most business apps, planning the backend from day one saves a painful rebuild later.

Agree or disagree? Tell us in the comments. 👇
